Independent Committee in relation to the  
Fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po  

_________________________________________________________  

2ND WITNESS STATEMENT OF  

CHENG KA-CHUN  

_________________________________________________________  

I, CHENG Ka-chun, Superintendent of Police, Hong Kong Police Force, of Detective Training Centre, No. 302 Wo Yi Hop Road, Kwai Chung, Hong Kong do say as follows:-  

1. I am the same CHENG Ka-chun who made my Witness Statement dated 29 January 2026 (“1st Witness Statement”) pursuant to the request of the Committee. Save where otherwise appears, I shall adopt the abbreviations and nomenclature used in my 1st Witness Statement.  

2. I make this Witness Statement pursuant to the request of the Committee as set out in a letter from Messrs. Lo and Lo, Solicitors for the Committee, to the Department of Justice dated 10 April 2026 (“10 April Letter”) in which the Force was requested to confirm whether the understanding set out at paragraphs a. to d. are correct. Save where otherwise appears, the facts deposed hereto are within my personal knowledge or are derived from office files and records and sources to which I have access and which are true to the best of my knowledge, information and belief.  

3. In this Witness Statement, I shall address paragraphs a. to d. of the 10 April Letter. References will be made to the S/N in the Composite List of Fatalities (“Composite List”) attached to the 3rd Witness Statement of Wong Cheung-hing dated 16 March 2026.
